subject: Access origination: Admin onboarding rally — SaaSify initial setup
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Torres <alyssa.t@saasify.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.w@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.l@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access origination: Admin onboarding rally — SaaSify initial setup

Hi Alyssa + team,

Thanks again for the signature — excited to get SaaSify across the finish line. To make the implementation kickoff efficient, I put together a short "Access Origination" rally plan that covers who creates the pieces, when we invite users, and how we seed the first API keys and project namespace. Attached: onboarding_scope_v1.pdf and provisioning_matrix.csv — skim the matrix and confirm the initial admin list.

Quick summary / asks (high level):
- Confirm two initial org admins (name + preferred email) for production workspace. Those accounts will be seeded with Owner role for the first 72 hours.
- Confirm whether SaaSify wants SAML/IdP (SAML metadata) or standard email invites for admin accounts. If SAML, send metadata.xml; we’ll configure SSO during the kickoff.
- We will create one protected project: saasify-prod-001 (you can rename later) and seed a short-lived admin API key used for integration smoke tests. We recommend rotating to a managed service account after validation.
- Proposed kickoff: Monday May 31, 10:00 PT — 45 minutes: quick walkthrough, SSO handoff, and provisioning checklist. Jonas will run the calendar invite.

Plan excerpt (what we will do on Day 0):
1) Create org (saasify.redwood) and project namespace: saasify-prod-001.
2) Seed "org-admin-1" service account and generate ephemeral API key (scoped to org:admin). Key TTL: 72h.
3) Invite two named human admins (if using email invites) or attach SAML mapping for group 'Redwood-Admins' (if using SSO).
4) Configure RBAC: roles -> Admin / Ops / Readonly with sample bindings attached.

If you can reply with the initial admin emails and SSO preference, we'll lock the plan and push the attachments into the shared onboarding doc.

Thanks — short and pragmatic here, happy to expand into a step-by-step runbook in the kickoff.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor | Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.k@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Alyssa Torres <alyssa.t@saasify.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.w@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Access origination: Admin onboarding rally — SaaSify initial setup

Neha — thanks, this looks good. Confirming the initial details from SaaSify side:

Initial admins (human):
- Alyssa Torres (alyssa.t@saasify.com) — primary admin
- Ramon Cortez (ramon.c@saasify.com) — backup admin / infra contact

We prefer SAML SSO. Attaching our IdP metadata: sso_metadata.xml. Procurement looped in (procurement@saasify.com) since they need the PO and final contract number before we open paid features.

Two small asks: 
1) Can the seeded API key be scoped to allow only model inference + read logs? We want to avoid full org-owner scope on the initial key.
2) On rotation: procurement requests that API key rotation schedule be documented in the mutual action plan (esp. TTL, rotation steps, where secrets land).

Kickoff works for Monday May 31, 10:00 PT — please send calendar invite and dial-in. We’ll have our IT person (Ramon) on the call for SSO details.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Torres | IT Manager
SaaSify, Inc.
alyssa.t@saasify.com | +1 (650) 555-2468

-----
Attachment: sso_metadata.xml (IdP metadata stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Torres <alyssa.t@saasify.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.w@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.l@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access origination: Admin onboarding rally — SaaSify initial setup

Thanks Alyssa — perfect. Two quick confirmations and actions from Redwood before the kickoff:

1) API key scope: we will seed an ephemeral key scoped to inference:invoke and logs:read only (no org:owner privileges). TTL: 72 hours. After validation we'll create a managed service account with a long-term key stored in your secrets manager (we'll document rotation steps in the mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx attachment).

2) SSO: Ramon, thanks for being available on the kickoff. Monica will pair with Ramon during the SSO exchange to map the 'Redwood-Admins' group to our Admin role. Marcus will pre-upload the metadata and test the binding in a staging tenant before the call.

Mutual action plan (short):
- May 31, 10:00 PT — Kickoff & SSO mapping (owners: Neha, Monica, Ramon)
- Jun 1 — Seed project + ephemeral API key (owner: Jonas)
- Jun 2 — Smoke tests and integration checks (owners: SaaSify devs + Marcus)
- Jun 4 — Confirm rotation to managed service account and close the action items (owners: Neha + procurement)

Commands / naming conventions (internal reference) — copy these exactly to avoid drift:
- Project namespace: saasify-prod-001
- Seeded admin service account id: saasify-org-admin-1
- Ephemeral key creation (internal API example):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>" \
    -d '{"project":"saasify-prod-001","scopes":["inference:invoke","logs:read"],"ttl":"72h"}'

I’ve attached the mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx and updated the provisioning_matrix.csv with the scoped key entry. Jonas, can you create the placeholder project and seed the admin account before 11:30 PT so we can use it in the kickoff demo?

Thanks everyone — see you on the call.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor | Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.w@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.l@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Access origination: Admin onboarding rally — SaaSify initial setup

Forwarding quick ops note: I scheduled the kickoff (Mon May 31, 10:00 PT) and added the calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/teams/neha/saasify-kickoff-20270531. I also created the placeholder project and seeded the service account as requested:

- Project: saasify-prod-001 (env: prod, owner: saasify.redwood)
- Service account: saasify-org-admin-1 (permission: temporary Owner)
- Ephemeral key: created and stored in secure workspace: https://app.redwood.com/secure/keys/seed/saasify-prod-001 (access restricted: Monica, Neha, Jonas, Marcus)

Next steps for ops on the call: hand the key to Neha to share with SaaSify via our secure transfer process, then reduce permissions to scoped inference:invoke + logs:read after smoke tests. I’ll be on the kickoff to ensure the SSO mapping goes smoothly.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber | Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
